brief.role: A returning customer of Fernway, an outdoor-gear shop, finishing a purchase on a laptop during a work break
brief.job: Pay for the two items in the cart with total confidence in what it costs, what is being bought, and what happens next — in under two minutes.
brief.consequence: An abandoned checkout is a lost sale, and surprise costs or unclear errors at the payment step are the leading cause; a customer who cannot tell whether the charge went through becomes a support incident.
facts: Fernway is an outdoor-gear retailer. The cart holds exactly two items: Cascade 32L Pack, colour Moss, quantity 1, $148.00; and TrailMug 450ml, colour Slate, quantity 2, $24.00 each.
Order math before any promo: subtotal $196.00; shipping $8.00 flat (Standard, 3–5 business days, already chosen — no other options exist at this step); tax $16.17; total $220.17.
The customer is signed in. Their shipping address is on file: Sam Reyes, 418 Alder Street, Portland, OR 97204, and is editable from this page.

Payment methods are exactly two: credit/debit card (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) and the ShopPay wallet. Card entry needs: card number, expiry MM/YY, security code, name on card. Billing address defaults to the shipping address with an option to differ.
A promo-code field exists. The only valid code is TRAIL10, worth $10.00 off the subtotal; any other code returns: "This code isn't valid or has expired."
If the card is declined, the processor returns only a generic decline. The order is not placed, nothing is charged, and everything the customer entered persists.

Placing the order charges the card immediately, shows an order number in the format FW-XXXXX, and a confirmation email follows. Returns are accepted for 30 days from delivery; that is the only returns fact available.

House style, supplied by the client's brand system and binding like any other fact: light pure white ground; 1 accent hue drawn from: blue, green, red; interface type is a grotesque sans set in mixed; display and interface type share one family; corners slightly rounded; borders hairline; shadows none; overall density moderate; standard chrome includes: input fields, checkboxes, toggle switch, dropdown select, buttons, payment method icons, top navigation bar, dividers; imagery register: none; backgrounds flat.

required_interactions: Fill the card fields and place the order
Apply an invalid promo code and recover, then apply TRAIL10
Trigger a card decline and recover without re-entering everything
required_states: default (address on file, full cart and cost summary)
acceptance_checks: Order contents and every cost line are visible before and at the moment of payment; the total the primary action charges is the total on screen.
Error states say what happened and what to do next without inventing processor detail; nothing entered is lost on a decline.
Only the supplied policies and trust facts render; no invented badges, guarantees, urgency, or payment options.
The moment of commitment is unmistakable: what will be charged, to which card, right now.
The build stays within the supplied house style register; the assigned direction expresses itself only within it.
